title: Audio and Video
description: HTML allows developers to add audio and video content directly to webpages using the <audio> and <video> tags.
These elements provide built-in controls that allow users to play, pause, and adjust media playback.
Audio and video enhance the user experience by providing multimedia content such as music, tutorials, presentations, and demonstrations without requiring additional software.

example.output: An audio player and a video player displayed on the webpage.
